messages:
Aisha (People Ops): Heads-up: Q3 company offsite is confirmed for Sep 12-14 at Pine Ridge Lodge (2.5 hrs north). Please read logistics and RSVP by Aug 20.

Jin (Eng): Quick Q 3 will remote-only folks be able to join virtually for the keynote?

Aisha (People Ops): Yes 3 we'll stream the main sessions and have a dedicated virtual room. But the in-person schedule has team breakouts and social dinners we can't replicate.

Marcus (Finance): Travel booking: we have a flight block for SFO/EWR/LHR hubs. If you book outside the block, attach receipts for reimbursement. Per-policy cap: $600 domestic, $1200 transatlantic.

Liam (Facilities): Shuttle pickup times from downtown transit hubs: Fri 06:30 / 08:00; Sun return 16:00 / 18:00. Capacity limited, book shuttle via DeskReserve -> "Offsite Shuttle" tag.

Tess (People Ops): Family + guest policy: employees may bring one partner or child. Guest meals included; guests must be added on the RSVP form by Aug 20 for catering and badges. No unregistered guests on site.

Jin (Eng): Childcare support? I have a toddler and would need help for the evenings.

Tess (People Ops): We can provide a childcare stipend up to $150 per night for eligible caregivers. Please file request on People Ops by Aug 15. We'll also have a quiet family room at the lodge.

Marcus (Finance): Per diem for meals not covered by event: $50/day. Save receipts.

Aisha (People Ops): COVID and health note: mask-optional at the lodge. If you test positive within 5 days prior to travel, please cancel and request exception via the form; we'll accommodate remote attendance and cover prepaid costs on a case-by-case basis.

Liam (Facilities): Luggage storage: Leave bags at reception on arrival. Valuables: use personal locks. Parking at the lodge is limited; carpool strongly recommended. We'll publish a carpool spreadsheet.

Jin (Eng): Any wardrobe rules for the closing dinner? :smile:

Aisha (People Ops): Casual with a smart layer. Weather can be cool evenings. Also bring hiking shoes if you want the Saturday morning trail run.

Marcus (Finance): Expense timeline: submit all offsite expenses by Oct 1. Late submissions may be processed next quarter.

Tess (People Ops): Accessibility: if you need ground-floor rooms, ramps, or dietary accommodations beyond the form options, DM People Ops and we'll arrange.

CalendarBot: Event created "Redwood Q3 Offsite 3 Pine Ridge Lodge" by Aisha. RSVP required: https://intranet.redwood/events/1770012345

Aisha (People Ops): TL;DR: Sep 12-14 Pine Ridge Lodge, RSVP by Aug 20, travel block + reimbursement caps, one guest allowed (register), childcare stipend available, shuttle booking via DeskReserve, submit expenses by Oct 1. Ping People Ops for exceptions. :party-parrot:
